rationale: Artem brings deep ML infrastructure expertise—real-time inference, transformers, and PyTorch systems—while Jake is actively building in the B2A space and believes founders optimizing at the lowest levels of the compute stack have an unfair advantage. Both are in New York and focused on AI infrastructure, making this a natural fit for exploring how cutting-edge ML systems could power the next generation of autonomous agent tooling.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Jake Fitzgerald — you're both focused on AI infrastructure from different angles (ML systems vs. founder tooling), and Jake's conviction on low-level compute optimization aligns perfectly with Artem's shipping background in real-time inference and model systems.
